# phasetwo_organizations (Data Source)

Every organization the API client belongs to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "phasetwo_organizations" "all" {}

output "organization_names" {
  value = [for o in data.phasetwo_organizations.all.organizations : o.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `organizations` (Attributes List) The organizations, in the order the API returned them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organizations))

<a id="nestedatt--organizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organizations`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `id` (String) ID of the organization.
- `name` (String) Name of the organization.
